issues.description: Field visibility mismatch for Person.firstName: The problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) documents the Person fields as private (indicated by '-' in the UML). The template implementation (template_repository/src/common/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java) declares firstName as private. The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/common/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java) declares firstName as public. This inconsistency about the access modifier for the field can confuse students about expected encapsulation and whether direct field access is intended or getters/setters should be used.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent by changing the solution's Person.firstName field to private to match the UML and the template. Rely on the existing getFirstName()/setFirstName() accessor methods for field access. This preserves encapsulation and avoids confusing differences between template, problem statement, and solution.
